agsci-2010-hl-scheme-p05-tooth.alt: Official marking-scheme drawing of a longitudinal section through a tooth, showing the crown and root, outer enamel, dentin, pulp, gum, periodontium, cementum, bone, blood vessels and nerves. The diagram has a two-mark tariff; four correctly positioned labels earn two marks each.
